county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Diapering Procedures - Caregiver's Hands Washed (26 TAC §746.3505(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregivers hands were observed to not be washed after a childs diaper was changed.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained I observed a caregiver pulling a child to the ground and holding in a restraint hold.

top_violation_types.title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Diaper changes were observed at inspection and the diaper changing surface was not sanitized after any of the diaper changes.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that caregivers did not promptly change a child's soiled diaper, resulting in a rash.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The allegation is related to a DFPS abuse/neglect investigation and found to be deficient. Based on interviews with children and daycare staff, it was determined a caregiver used profane language towards children in care.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.
